title: supplier.offer.price-changed
description: Supplier's base price for (account x product) changed. Emitted only on an actual change vs. the previous synced value. Topic: sa.supplier.offer, key: offer_id.

offer_id.description: ULID of the Offer (supplier_account x supplier_product)

old_price.description: Previous base price as decimal string; null on first observation

new_price.description: New base price as decimal string (never float)

currency.description: ISO-4217, supplier settlement currency of this account

rrp_uah.description: Recommended retail price if supplier provides it

observed_at.description: When the connector observed the new value at the supplier
